title: Mobile checkout refinement verified
summary: Readable summary and payment cards checked at four viewport widths; compact progress and accessible payment state corrected during verification.

changes.detail: Reduced compact progress horizontal padding after finding a clipped label at 320px.
Explicit button roles for summary controls and radio role with checked state for payment options.
Verified the compact progress, softer background, reduced summary padding, readable labels, product price below details, and stronger selected payment outline.
Duplicate product quantity and unused trailing-price column styles removed.

validation.name: Mobile TypeScript
validation.detail: npm.cmd run typecheck completed after final changes.

validation.name: Responsive browser interaction checks
validation.detail: Headless Edge on localhost:8081 at widths 320, 390, 490, 768: summary expands/collapses, PayPal checked state updates, cash-on-delivery can be reselected, and no document horizontal overflow. Isolated session uses synthetic cart/address and intercepted API responses; no order submitted.

validation.name: Visual review
validation.detail: Inspected collapsed 390px and corrected expanded 320px screenshots; remaining content is scrollable above the persistent confirmation footer. Synthetic product has no image.

validation.name: Initial browser check correction
validation.detail: Initial selection assertion failed because checked state was not exposed; added explicit aria-checked and reran successfully.

validation.name: History integrity
validation.detail: Append command preserved earlier reports; --check passed before this follow-up and is rerun afterward.

validation.name: Unverified limits
validation.detail: Native iOS/Android, real payment/order submission, live backend behavior and other languages not tested. No deployment.
